The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracker, based on 135,005 responses from registered voters collected between January 20, 2025, and October 8, 2026.

## Key Points [...] ## Key Points

 Trump has a negative net approval rating in 39 states, according to the latest Civiqs figures, including states with competitive Senate races such as Texas (-20), Iowa (- 21), Ohio (-18) and Alaska (-16).
 The president's highest net approval rating is in Wyoming (+14), North Dakota (+11) and West Virginia (+10).
 Trump's net approval rating has recently turned negative in several states where it was steadily positive until earlier this year.
